output.content:
Marvell’s Data Center segment accounted for **79% of total revenue** in its latest reported quarter, **Q2 fiscal 2027 (quarter ended August 1, 2026)**. [[1, 2]] 

That corresponds to **$2.172 billion** of Data Center revenue out of **$2.739 billion** of total net revenue (approximately 79.3% before the company’s whole-percent presentation rounding). [[2]]

sources.title: Marvell Technology, Inc. Reports Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
